newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares end up on rebound.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares end up on rebound.

text.p: Shenzhen B share index ended up on Wednesday on a technical rebound after an official denial that there had been a major deterioration in the health of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping, brokers said.
The index rose 4.03 points or 2.93 percent to 141.75 on volume of 28.102 million shares worth HK$142.104 million.
The B share index lost 9.58 percent on Tuesday.
China's foreign ministry said on Tuesday there had been no major change in the health of the ailing 92-year-old patriarch Deng Xiaoping.
